rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH lung_diseases AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM disease
  WHERE name ILIKE '%lung%'
),
de_lung AS (
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    doid,
    log2fc,
    adjpvalue,
    expression_change_direction,
    subjects_up,
    subjects_down,
    subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression
  WHERE doid IN (SELECT id FROM lung_diseases)
),
dm_with_gene AS (
  SELECT
    dm.id AS disease_mutation_id,
    dm.doid AS doid,
    dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
    mpdm.uniprotkb_ac,
    xge.gene_symbol,
    dmt.uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM disease_mutation dm
  JOIN disease_mutation_tissue dmt
    ON dmt.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
  LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mpdm
    ON mpdm.ensembl_transcript_id = dm.ensembl_transcript_id
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xge
    ON xge.ensembl_gene_id = mpdm.ensembl_transcript_id
  WHERE dm.doid IN (SELECT id FROM lung_diseases)
),
dm_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(xe.gene_symbol, mwg.ensembl_transcript_id) AS gene_symbol,
    doid,
    count(DISTINCT disease_mutation_id) AS mutation_count,
    array_agg(DISTINCT uberon_anatomical_id) FILTER (WHERE uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL) AS uberon_ids
  FROM dm_with_gene mwg
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xe
    ON xe.ensembl_gene_id = mwg.ensembl_transcript_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(xe.gene_symbol, mwg.ensembl_transcript_id), doid
),
lung_anatomical_ids AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM anatomical_entity
  WHERE
    lower(name) LIKE '%lung%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%pulmon%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%bronch%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%alveol%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%pleura%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%airway%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%trachea%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%respirat%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%bronchiol%'
    OR lower(name) LIKE '%pulmo%'
),
healthy_lung_expr AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    xg.gene_symbol,
    avg(he.expression_score) AS avg_expression_score,
    array_agg(DISTINCT he.expression_level_gene_relative) AS levels
  FROM healthy_expression he
  JOIN lung_anatomical_ids la ON he.uberon_anatomical_id = la.id
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xg ON xg.ensembl_gene_id = he.ensembl_gene_id
  GROUP BY he.ensembl_gene_id, xg.gene_symbol
),
-- collect genes from sources; carry doid where available
genes_union AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gene_symbol, doid FROM de_lung WHERE gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT gene_symbol, doid FROM dm_agg WHERE gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT hl.gene_symbol, ld.id AS doid
  FROM healthy_lung_expr hl
  CROSS JOIN lung_diseases ld
  WHERE hl.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  gu.gene_symbol,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM de_lung d WHERE d.gene_symbol = gu.gene_symbol AND d.doid = gu.doid) THEN 'differential_expression'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dm_agg m WHERE m.gene_symbol = gu.gene_symbol AND m.doid = gu.doid) THEN 'disease_mutation'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM healthy_lung_expr h WHERE h.gene_symbol = gu.gene_symbol) THEN 'healthy_expression'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS evidence_source,
  gu.doid AS disease_id,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'differential_expression',
      (SELECT to_jsonb(d) - ARRAY['doid'] FROM de_lung d WHERE d.gene_symbol = gu.gene_symbol AND d.doid = gu.doid LIMIT 1),
    'mutation_summary',
      (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
         'mutation_count', m.mutation_count,
         'uberon_ids', m.uberon_ids
       )
       FROM dm_agg m
       WHERE m.gene_symbol = gu.gene_symbol AND m.doid = gu.doid
       LIMIT 1),
    'healthy_expression',
      (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
         'ensembl_gene_id', h.ensembl_gene_id,
         'avg_expression_score', h.avg_expression_score,
         'expression_level_gene_relative_samples', h.levels
       )
       FROM healthy_lung_expr h
       WHERE h.gene_symbol = gu.gene_symbol
       LIMIT 1)
  ) AS additional_info
FROM genes_union gu
ORDER BY gu.gene_symbol NULLS LAST

rows.question: What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_by_gene_disease AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    de.doid AS doid,
    de.log2fc AS log2fc,
    de.pvalue AS pvalue,
    de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
    de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
    de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction,
    de.subjects_up AS subjects_up,
    de.subjects_down AS subjects_down,
    de.subjects_total AS subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression de
),
disease_core AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS id,
    d.name AS name
  FROM disease d
),
gene_to_disease_expression_join AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    de.doid AS doid,
    d.id AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    de.log2fc AS log2fc,
    de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
    de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
    de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction
  FROM differential_expression_by_gene_disease de

    ON de.doid = d.id
)
SELECT DISTINCT disease_name
FROM gene_to_disease_expression_join
WHERE gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND expression_change_direction ILIKE '%up%'
  AND (
    (adjpvalue IS NOT NULL AND adjpvalue < 0.05)

  )

rows.question: Show name of diseases where the A1BG gene expression is statistically significant
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_records AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid,
    de.log2fc,
    de.pvalue,
    de.adjpvalue,
    de.statistical_significance,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    de.subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression de
),
disease_core AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS id,
    d.name AS name
  FROM disease d
),
gene_to_disease_significant_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    dr.gene_symbol,
    dr.doid,
    dr.log2fc,
    dr.adjpvalue,
    dr.pvalue,
    dr.statistical_significance,
    dr.expression_change_direction
  FROM differential_expression_records dr
  WHERE
    (
      -- textual significance flag present and likely indicates significance
      dr.statistical_significance IS NOT NULL
      AND dr.statistical_significance <> ''
      AND dr.statistical_significance ILIKE '%signif%'
    )
    OR
    (
      -- numeric adjusted p-value threshold
      dr.adjpvalue IS NOT NULL
      AND dr.adjpvalue < 0.05
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.name
FROM gene_to_disease_significant_cohort g
JOIN disease_core d ON g.doid = d.id
WHERE g.gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
ORDER BY d.name

rows.question: What is the test trade name for FDA tests which are actually used for predisposition?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fda_test_use_rows AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    test_trade_name,
    test_submission,
    approved_indication,
    actual_use
  FROM biomarker_fda_test_use
),
fda_test_core AS (
  -- pick a canonical row per test_trade_name (deterministic)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.test_trade_name)
    t.test_trade_name,
    t.test_submission,
    t.test_manufacturer,
    t.test_approval_status,
    t.clinical_significance,
    t.test_number_genes,
    t.platform_method
  FROM biomarker_fda_test t
  ORDER BY t.test_trade_name, COALESCE(t.test_submission, '') ASC
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  COALESCE(fcore.test_trade_name, fussr.test_trade_name) AS test_trade_name
FROM fda_test_use_rows fussr
LEFT JOIN fda_test_core fcore
  ON fussr.test_trade_name = fcore.test_trade_name
WHERE (
    fussr.actual_use ILIKE '%predispos%'
    OR fussr.actual_use ILIKE '%predisposition%'
    OR fussr.approved_indication ILIKE '%predispos%'
    OR fussr.approved_indication ILIKE '%predisposition%'
)
ORDER BY test_trade_name

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.gene_symbol, ''), xg.gene_symbol) AS gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
    NULLIF(upper(btrim(b.biomarker_id)), '') AS biomarker_id,
    COALESCE(b.test_is_a_panel, false) AS test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xg
    ON xg.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (b.gene_symbol IS NULL OR b.gene_symbol = '')
    AND xg.speciesid = 9606
    AND xg.ensembl_gene_id = (
      CASE
        WHEN b.biomarker_id IS NOT NULL AND b.biomarker_id ~* '^ENSG\\d{11}$' THEN b.biomarker_id
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )
),
disease_by_name AS (
  SELECT
    d.id,
    d.name
  FROM disease d
  WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
),
biomarker_disease_link_via_edrn AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id_internal,
    b.gene_symbol AS biomarker_gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
    e.id AS edrn_id,
    e.biomarker_title AS edrn_biomarker_title,
    e.biomarker_type AS edrn_biomarker_type,
    e.uberon_anatomical_id AS edrn_uberon_anatomical_id,
    e.phase AS edrn_phase,
    e.qa_state AS edrn_qa_state
  FROM biomarker_core b
  JOIN biomarker_edrn e
    ON b.id = e.id
)
SELECT DISTINCT bc.gene_symbol,
       bc.biomarker_description
FROM disease_by_name d
-- The biomarker_edrn.uberon_anatomical_id holds an Uberon id; disease.id is a numeric doid.
-- The original attempt joined these directly which is unlikely to match. Instead join biomarker_edrn to cancer_tissue by uberon id,
-- then link cancer_tissue.do id to disease.id to get biomarkers associated with that disease.
JOIN biomarker_disease_link_via_edrn edrn
  ON edrn.edrn_uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL
JOIN cancer_tissue ct
  ON ct.uberon_anatomical_id = edrn.edrn_uberon_anatomical_id
  AND ct.doid IS NOT NULL
JOIN disease d2
  ON d2.id = ct.doid
  AND d2.id = d.id
JOIN biomarker_core bc
  ON bc.id = edrn.biomarker_id_internal
ORDER BY bc.gene_symbol
